create_scale_factor_module: create a ScaleFactor module to scale PyTorch tensors by a learned factor
fit_scale_factor_variance: fit a ScaleFactor by computing variance ratio between input and output tensors
observe_tensor_variance: observe input and reference tensor variances during the fitting context for scale calculation
set_scale_factor_value: set the scale factor value directly on a fitted or unfitted ScaleFactor module
reset_scale_factor: reset a ScaleFactor module by zeroing its scale factor parameter
